correctness.notes: oracle passed on every measured cell | 18 cells reported unsupported by the adapter's supported(), listed in correctness.unsupported_cells | 74 cells dropped for lack of a control value (a cell-list batch run under the other requirement carries the same cells without the reference's path, their twins with a control are in the card), for example N128 k64 bf16 prefer_smaller_index latency | phase 3 final evaluation, harness 0.10, nodes umbriel-b200-047, umbriel-b200-068 | cells come from more than one node, see the node field of every cell: umbriel-b200-047, umbriel-b200-068

low_level: Registers 32 to 255 over the 448 distinct kernels behind the card's cells (64 with register spills, a kernel measured in more than one batch counts once), shared memory 288 to 131072 bytes, harness 0.10 on umbriel-b200-047, umbriel-b200-068.
Adapter statics: input arrangement blocked, output indices, temp storage 256 to 8192 bytes.
Oracle battery (23 cases per cell plus the measurement seeds) passed on every cell that has a number, 18 cells unsupported by the adapter's contract or the device, no cell failed the oracle.
algorithmic: Random input (the one-node matrix on umbriel-b200-047): latency not_guaranteed wins 2 of 83 cells (runner-up in 6), latency prefer_smaller_index wins 2 of 66 cells (runner-up in 6), throughput not_guaranteed wins 2 of 81 cells (runner-up in 2), throughput prefer_smaller_index wins 3 of 66 cells (runner-up in 1).
Where it wins on random input (bf16 N 2048, bf16 N 4096, fp32 N 2048, fp32 N 4096), the median margin over the runner-up is +12 percent and over the scope's reference control +332 percent.

Largest random-input deficits (distinct cells, worst regime): bf16 N 4096 k 4 +2075 percent behind W2_packed_v3 in latency not_guaranteed, fp32 N 4096 k 4 +1176 percent behind W5_v4 in throughput prefer_smaller_index, bf16 N 128 k 4 +1113 percent behind W2_packed_v3 in latency not_guaranteed, bf16 N 4096 k 16 +1095 percent behind W5_v4 in latency prefer_smaller_index.

Tie-heavy input (unshuffled, umbriel-b200-068): latency not_guaranteed wins 6 of 40 cells (runner-up in 3), latency prefer_smaller_index wins 6 of 37 cells (runner-up in 3), throughput not_guaranteed wins 2 of 40 cells (runner-up in 6), throughput prefer_smaller_index wins 2 of 37 cells (runner-up in 6).
negative: No cell where this adapter was the winner changed hands against the control in the same lock section. Deficits above are against other adapters of the same scope.
surprises: None beyond what the tables show.
